rules.universe_gate: Defined molecule, reference formula/CID/InChIKey; food scope retained; flagged uncertain food origin held for clarification
rules.review_queue_gate: At least one independent H-ORAC pure-compound study confirmed in preserved Stage25B6D closure
queue_order: At least two confirmed studies first (evidence reliability, not potency)
Typed SD available first within the same reliability stratum
Stable candidate_id for unresolved ties only
rules.cutoff_tie_rule: Report the full tied set; ID order is an administrative 20-slot preview, not a scientific tie-break
formal_panel_gate: exact reagent form and procurement verified
rules.missing_values: Unknown is distinct from zero and never evidence of inactivity
rules.counter_scenario: One-confirmed-study threshold vs two-confirmed-study threshold; no forced filling if fewer than 20
